recommendations.detail: Viewer Shweta said she already holds 250 shares of Sona BLW. Kutumba Rao said Sona BLW is going to be a multibagger and there is no doubt whatsoever in that. The company frustrated and exhausted investors for two years and has now started performing. From here it will gallop -- 'that's for sure.'

recommendations.note: You can buy it. Not a bad stock; hold at 650 as the result is still to come and should be decent enough.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Shweta asked about buying Sandhar Technologies at the current price and the anchor directed the follow-up to Kutumba Rao by name. He said you can buy it and he would say own it; if you have already bought, it is not a bad stock. Looking carefully at the last one year, a stock that had fallen to around 400 recovered remarkably to 750 and is now stabilising. At 650 he would say hold, because the result is still to come and would be decent enough; the March-ending result was also better profitability-wise and the top line grew.

recommendations.price: OFS price ~10% below the IPO price
recommendations.note: Look at it more like a mutual fund than a multibagger. Value exists in the stock; retail investor's time will also come.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Satish asked whether LIC offers the kind of 10-20 year multibagger opportunity one hears about, and the anchor asked Kutumba Rao by name whether he has any such hope. He said one should look at LIC more like a mutual fund; rather than a multibagger, definitely there is value in the stock, no doubt about that. Yesterday's result was better than expectations. He noted how quietly the government encashed Rs 31,000 crore through the offer for sale and that the timing benefited the government, not the retail investor -- but the retail investor's time will come too. Put a little harshly, 'every dog will have its day'; at some point LIC's time will come.
